main_result: The accepted spatial investigation does not yet contain a dedicated substantive synthesis of redistribution of the fixed 1985 pasture cohort.
numeric_evidence: No Phase 4-8 accepted finding answers RQ1 directly.
interpretation_boundary: Do not infer redistribution results from process-flow maps; extract the accepted cohort-accounting outputs before manuscript synthesis.

main_result: The accepted spatial investigation does not yet synthesize the shares of consolidation originating from left-censored, new, unresolved-age and unattributed pasture.
numeric_evidence: No Phase 4-8 accepted finding provides the complete origin partition required by RQ2.
interpretation_boundary: The accounting identity may be validated upstream, but substantive origin shares require a dedicated extraction from accepted stock-flow outputs.

main_result: Detected intermediate pasture represents a small share of accumulated endpoint NAT-to-TMP area in the primary high-magnitude cohort.
numeric_evidence: Pasture detected in at least one intermediate year = 6.51% of accumulated NAT-to-TMP area in the cohort.
interpretation_boundary: This percentage is cohort-specific and sums interval areas; it is not the full-domain share and does not deduplicate pixels across intervals.

main_result: Absence of detected pasture in the annual series does not establish direct native-vegetation-to-crop conversion.
numeric_evidence: Other intermediate states and classification instability remain possible.
interpretation_boundary: Use 'no pasture detected' rather than 'direct conversion' unless every intermediate state is evaluated.

main_result: Replenishment exceeds consolidation in aggregate in every five-year interval.
numeric_evidence: Aggregate C-R index is negative in all eight intervals, from -0.838 in 1985-1990 to -0.656 in diagnostic 2020-2025.
interpretation_boundary: Aggregate dominance does not imply that every cell is replenishment-dominant.

main_result: A small fixed group of high-magnitude cells contains most accumulated endpoint NAT-to-TMP area.
numeric_evidence: 2,598 cells = 10.44% of the domain and 87.5% of accumulated 1985-2020 NAT-to-TMP area.
interpretation_boundary: The cohort is selected retrospectively and is not random or itself a statistical cluster.

main_result: High-cohort NAT-to-TMP activity peaks in 2000-2005 and declines strongly by 2015-2020.
numeric_evidence: 2.116 million ha in 2000-2005 versus 0.546 million ha in 2015-2020; decline = 74.2%.
interpretation_boundary: Decline in high-class area does not mean disappearance of all NAT-to-TMP activity.

main_result: The activity-weighted center of the high cohort shifts north/northeast over the primary period.
numeric_evidence: Approximate net displacement = 692 km between 1985-1990 and 2015-2020.
interpretation_boundary: This is redistribution of activity weights among fixed cells, not tracking of identical pixels or a causal frontier trajectory.

main_result: Recent high-cohort balance differs between biomes: Amazon is consolidation-dominant while Cerrado remains mixed.
interpretation_boundary: These are ratios of regional flow sums, not means of cell indices or classifications of all cells.

main_result: Recent consolidation dominance is more persistent among high-cohort Amazon cells than Cerrado cells.
numeric_evidence: Dominant in both late intervals: Amazon 367/648 = 56.6%; Cerrado 427/1,950 = 21.9%.
interpretation_boundary: Persistence is defined at five-year cell state, not annual or pixel-level continuity.

main_result: Persistent late consolidation and earlier reversals coexist; there is no universal linear replenishment-to-consolidation succession.
numeric_evidence: Any direct or mediated reversal: Amazon 83.0%; Cerrado 57.2%.
interpretation_boundary: Repeated transitions from the same cell are descriptive and are not independent probabilities from a fitted model.

main_result: All canonical Global Moran tests show positive spatial association and remain significant after BY correction.
numeric_evidence: 104/104 tests positive and BY-significant; 9,999 permutations per test.
interpretation_boundary: Global Moran establishes overall association but does not locate clusters or imply causal processes.

main_result: Several absolute process metrics have lower Global Moran coefficients late in the primary period than initially.
numeric_evidence: Consolidation 0.799 to 0.559; replenishment 0.770 to 0.614; NAT-to-TMP 0.550 to 0.361.
interpretation_boundary: Separate interval permutation tests do not test the significance of between-date differences or a temporal trend.

main_result: Replenishment has the broadest and most persistent absolute-process HH structure.
numeric_evidence: 18,067 HH cell-map records; 4,354 cells with primary HH persistence; mean adjacent HH Jaccard = 0.389.
interpretation_boundary: HH denotes locally high values relative to the map and significant neighbors; it is not a causal region.

main_result: Endpoint NAT-to-TMP HH clusters are fewer and more temporally variable than replenishment clusters.
numeric_evidence: 3,134 HH cell-map records; 664 persistent cells; mean adjacent HH Jaccard = 0.260.
interpretation_boundary: Large significant totals in some maps are dominated by LL zero-rich structure and must not be described as extensive hotspots.

main_result: The bounded C-R index has the strongest adjacent HH stability among the primary local results.
numeric_evidence: 19,358 HH cell-map records; 3,543 persistent HH cells; mean adjacent HH Jaccard = 0.620.
interpretation_boundary: HH means relatively high index within active support; substantive consolidation dominance still requires index > +1/3.

main_result: Local significance is materially sensitive to the conservative BY correction.
numeric_evidence: BY retains 72,221 of 168,860 BH-significant cell-map records = 42.77%.
interpretation_boundary: BH remains the prespecified primary rule; highlighted clusters may be labelled BY-robust only when they pass BY.

main_result: Consolidation and endpoint NAT-to-TMP are Cerrado-associated over the primary period, while replenishment totals are similar with a slightly larger Amazon contribution.
numeric_evidence: Million ha: consolidation Amazon 5.10 vs Cerrado 15.02; replenishment 47.81 vs 45.81; NAT-to-TMP 2.04 vs 7.11.
interpretation_boundary: Primary-biome assignment attributes whole cells and is not an exact pixel partition by biome.
source_locator: Process magnitude and changing biome contributions

main_result: NAT-to-TMP magnitude classes are more dynamic through time in Cerrado than Amazon.
numeric_evidence: Mean state changes: Amazon 0.79, Cerrado 2.13; constant trajectories: 68.0% vs 18.0%.
interpretation_boundary: State changes are five-year cell classes and do not track annual pixel trajectories.

main_result: Cerrado contributes more persistent HH cells for consolidation, NAT-to-TMP and C-R balance, whereas Amazon contributes more for replenishment.
numeric_evidence: Persistent replenishment HH: Amazon 2,785 vs Cerrado 1,569; persistent NAT-to-TMP HH: 153 vs 511.
interpretation_boundary: These are biome contributions to the accepted combined-domain LISA pattern, not newly fitted within-biome Local Moran models.

main_result: The principal biome comparisons are stable when all 582 transbiome cells are removed.
numeric_evidence: All 160 Global Moran significance decisions retained; maximum absolute I change = 0.044848.
interpretation_boundary: Stability does not make primary-biome totals exact within-biome pixel totals.

main_result: Aggregate signs, dominance classes and temporal extrema are robust to alternative scale and zoning, while some conditional distributions are sensitive.
numeric_evidence: All 192 aggregate and 48 temporal comparisons pass; shifted 20k passes all components; 10k and 40k have distribution/support sensitivities.
interpretation_boundary: Robust aggregate behavior does not guarantee invariance of cell-level distributions.

main_result: The positive direction and formal significance of global spatial clustering are robust across alternative grids.
numeric_evidence: 120/120 alternative coefficients positive and BY-significant; 119/120 interval magnitude checks pass.
interpretation_boundary: Exact coefficient magnitudes and temporal ranking are separate robustness criteria.

main_result: Exact Global Moran magnitudes and temporal ordering show partial MAUP sensitivity concentrated in NAT-to-TMP.
numeric_evidence: One interval magnitude failure and 8/30 strict temporal failures; all six aggregate grid-window assessments fail at least one strict criterion.
interpretation_boundary: Failure of a strict comparison does not imply absence of positive spatial autocorrelation.

main_result: HH location and persistence are robust for replenishment, net C-R balance and the bounded C-R index.
numeric_evidence: Each metric passes 6/6 grid-window assessments; interval passes are 24/24, 23/24 and 24/24 respectively.
interpretation_boundary: Agreement is broad area-weighted footprint agreement, not cell-for-cell identity.

main_result: Consolidation HH recurrence and persistence are recognizable, but interval footprint location is scale-sensitive.
numeric_evidence: 3/6 complete assessments pass; 16/24 interval maps pass.
interpretation_boundary: Describe as partial robustness rather than either full invariance or invalidity.

main_result: Endpoint NAT-to-TMP HH footprint location and persistence are sensitive to spatial scale and zoning.
numeric_evidence: 0/6 complete assessments and 7/24 interval comparisons pass.
interpretation_boundary: Many failures retain high overlap coefficients, indicating footprint expansion or contraction around partly shared cores rather than universal relocation.

main_result: The canonical approximately 20,000-ha grid remains the primary analytical support after the MAUP assessment.
numeric_evidence: Phase 8A-E completed; alternative grids remain sensitivity analyses.
interpretation_boundary: Primary status does not erase metric-specific MAUP sensitivity and must be reported with qualifications.

main_result: The diagnostic interval reinforces some sensitivity findings but does not create the principal NAT-to-TMP MAUP result.
numeric_evidence: NAT-to-TMP is already sensitive in 1985-2020; 2020-2025 additionally affects full-window 40k consolidation.
interpretation_boundary: Diagnostic evidence is included and flagged but does not replace primary-period conclusions.

main_result: The accepted evidence supports spatial and temporal association, concentration and persistence statements, not causal attribution.
numeric_evidence: No commodity-price, infrastructure, policy, tenure or causal-design model is included in Phases 1-8.
interpretation_boundary: Do not translate descriptive or spatial-inference results into causal drivers.
